proxy.traefik:
# Traefik reference config for raneto, generated by the hub from its image.yml.
# Labels for the raneto service in your compose file. Traefik's docker provider must reach the raneto
# container on a shared network; the entrypoint websecure and the certificate resolver letsencrypt are
# examples from a typical Traefik setup. Replace example.com with your domain. Websockets need nothing extra.
services:
  raneto:
    labels:
      - traefik.enable=true
      - traefik.http.services.raneto.loadbalancer.server.port=3000
      - traefik.http.routers.raneto.rule=Host(`raneto.example.com`)
      - traefik.http.routers.raneto.entrypoints=websecure
      - traefik.http.routers.raneto.tls.certresolver=letsencrypt
      - traefik.http.routers.raneto.service=raneto
      # Authentication: uncomment one; the middleware is defined in your Traefik config.
      # - traefik.http.routers.raneto.middlewares=authelia@docker
      # - traefik.http.routers.raneto.middlewares=authentik@docker

kubernetes:
# Raneto: generated by the hub from https://github.com/linuxserver-playground/docker-raneto/blob/master/image.yml
# Storage sizes are placeholders; secrets belong in a Secret, not this ConfigMap.
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: raneto-env
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: raneto
    app.kubernetes.io/managed-by: linuxserver-hub
data:
  PUID: '1000'
  PGID: '1000'
  TZ: Etc/UTC
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: PersistentVolumeClaim
metadata:
  name: raneto-config
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: raneto
    app.kubernetes.io/managed-by: linuxserver-hub
spec:
  accessModes:
  - ReadWriteOnce
  resources:
    requests:
      storage: 1Gi
---
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: raneto
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: raneto
    app.kubernetes.io/managed-by: linuxserver-hub
spec:
  replicas: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app.kubernetes.io/name: raneto
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app.kubernetes.io/name: raneto
        app.kubernetes.io/managed-by: linuxserver-hub
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: raneto
        image: ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/raneto:latest
        imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent
        envFrom:
        - configMapRef:
            name: raneto-env
        ports:
        - name: port-3000
          containerPort: 3000
          protocol: TCP
        volumeMounts:
        - name: raneto-config
          mountPath: /config
      volumes:
      - name: raneto-config
        persistentVolumeClaim:
          claimName: raneto-config
  strategy:
    type: Recreate
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: raneto
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: raneto
    app.kubernetes.io/managed-by: linuxserver-hub
spec:
  selector:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: raneto
  ports:
  - name: port-3000
    port: 3000
    targetPort: 3000
    protocol: TCP
quadlet:
# raneto.container: generated by the hub from https://github.com/linuxserver-playground/docker-raneto/blob/master/image.yml
# Optional parameters are commented out.

[Unit]
Description=Raneto (LinuxServer.io)
After=network-online.target
Wants=network-online.target

[Container]
Image=ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/raneto:latest
ContainerName=raneto
AutoUpdate=registry
Environment=PUID=1000
Environment=PGID=1000
Environment=TZ=Etc/UTC
Volume=/path/to/raneto/data:/config:Z
PublishPort=3000:3000

[Service]
Restart=always
TimeoutStartSec=900

[Install]
WantedBy=default.target
